bibliographic.title: Last Adventure
bibliographic.author: Mavridis Philippe a.k.a. blu.256
bibliographic.description:
Last Adventure is a Twine game in Greek. It follows the adventures of one Mr. Mortimer who is suddenly awakened with a scary early-morning scream. He has to dive into his memories, solve some puzzles and make some decisions which will determine nothing less than his fate.

It includes background music, some pictures and several text animations.
